title: Money in Tanzania: Cash, Cards and ATMs
excerpt: Shillings, dollars, cards and ATMs: how to handle money in Tanzania, for tips, souvenirs and daily expenses.
body:
The currency of Tanzania is the Tanzanian shilling (TZS).

## Cash

- Shillings are used for everyday expenses.
- US dollars are widely accepted in tourism, but often only clean notes printed after a certain year. Bring newer notes in good condition.
- Bring small denominations for tips and small purchases.

## ATMs

ATMs are available in cities and larger towns, such as Arusha, Moshi and Stone Town. There are none in national parks. Withdraw enough before your safari.

## Cards

Visa and Mastercard are accepted in many hotels and lodges, sometimes with a surcharge. Smaller shops and markets often only take cash.

## Exchange

Exchange money at banks or official bureaux de change. Avoid exchanging on the street.

## Tips

Most trips include a safari guide. See [tipping in Tanzania](/blog/tipping-tanzania/).

## Safety

Do not carry all your cash at once. Use the safe in your room.

See our [practical information](/practical-information/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
